newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's Nov 8 foreign reserves at $8.3 bln.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's Nov 8 foreign reserves at $8.3 bln.

text.p: Colombia's net foreign reserves totalled $8.3 billion as of November 8, the most recent date for which official figures are available, the central bank said on Friday.
The reserve figure was the highest reported by the central bank, or Banco de la Republica, since January 13.
Net reserves have decreased by $24 million, or 0.3 percent, since December 30 of last year but are up slightly from November 10, 1995, when net reserves reportedly totalled $8.28 billion.
